hypothesis: Read standard local Sentence Transformers module metadata to make previously unlisted, compatible text encoders executable without editing the Agent. Let them compete on observed training feedback under the existing generic policy. Supplying an asset directory is the environment preparation, not an agent decision to download weights.
installation: Mirror the full existing resource directory into a separate research directory. Complete official module and pooling metadata for all-mpnet-base-v2 and all-distilroberta-v1, and include one newly installed general short-sentence model, paraphrase-MiniLM-L3-v2. Verify upstream file sizes and git object / LFS hashes at pinned author revisions. Never use a model trained explicitly for this course task. Model names occur only in the study inventory, not the runtime plugin.
entry: Use the ordinary unified raw course solve. The input is the released train package, unlabeled prediction file, one directory, and numeric limits only. No policy flag, method names, sampled candidates, old scores, rules, strategy, order or winners. Freeze runtime and menu, record every physical classifier fit, true confirmed finalists, and a separate-process uncached exported prediction.
prior: Keep the previous 28-fit available study (25 fits used) and the default 10-fit handoff fixed. Check candidate identities after a directory rename, ensure raw file/no pooling does not trigger guessed loading, check prohibition of pretrained assets on a separate contract, and run a genuine independent single-text trial with a new discovered model and fresh-process prediction. Proposals free to lose or not be explored. Keep the established published release unless integrated evidence supports a change.
scoring: Score an external validation output only when sealed and independently reloaded. Reuse an existing result on exact prediction match when possible. Training-only evidence drives decisions. No course test, no H2, no paid API.
